title: Late-Time Unconfined Pumping 2D
deck: This `v1` case validates one transient non-confined pumping response in a pragmatic way.
summary: This `v1` case validates one transient non-confined pumping response in a pragmatic way.
case_setup: geometry: square Cartesian grid (`101 x 101`, single layer),
all outer boundaries: fixed at the initial head,
forcing: one constant pumping well at the domain center,
Available solver variants: MODFLOW-NWT, MODFLOW 6, Boussinesq.
what_it_shows: Transient well forcing, late-time radial drawdown scaling, and numerical radial symmetry around the well
Primary metrics: space-time RMSE, space-time max abs error, final-time RMSE, final-time max abs error, azimuthal spread.
Solver-specific figures and metrics are shown side by side so the same benchmark can be read across backends.
reference_highlights: the analytical reference is intentionally limited to the late-time regime,
drawdown is compared against the Theis well function using `T = K * href` and `S = Sy`,
early delayed-yield effects are excluded from the comparison window.
